from datetime import datetime
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, IntegerType, StringType, TimestampType

# 1. Define sample data matching your external table schema
data = [
    (1, "Alice Johnson", "ON", datetime(2026, 11, 11, 10, 0, 0)),
    (2, "Bob Tremblay", "QC", datetime(2026, 11, 11, 10, 5, 0)),
    (3, "Charlie Singh", "BC", datetime(2026, 11, 11, 10, 10, 0))
]

schema = StructType([
    StructField("CustomerID", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("FullName", StringType(), True),
    StructField("Province", StringType(), True),
    StructField("UpdatedAt", TimestampType(), True)
])

df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)

# 2. Write as a Delta table to your exact ADLS Gen2 path
delta_path = "abfss://azuresynapsevcc@azuresynapsevcc.dfs.core.windows.net/vccfamily/vcc-root/customers/"
df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").save(delta_path)

print("Delta table created successfully!")
